messages:
alex: Hey team — Armada (HW partner) wants a joint perf/W benchmarking doc + public call next Tue. They want apples-to-apples numbers across our runtime and their newest board. Can someone own test matrix + kernel tuning plan?

vikram: I can own kernel tuning + automation. Need clarification: target model(s)? int8 quant or fp16? Armada mentioned Llama-2-7b and a 70b variant.

alex: Goal: Llama-2-7b int8 and 13b fp16 as primary. Focus on tokens/sec/W and p99 latency. Must include cold/warm cache and batching points (1/4/8/16).

natalie: I'll setup measurement infra. Plan to use nvml sampling at 1s, `scripts/energy_probe.sh` for wall-power capture, and trace token throughput with our request-tracer. Need a test harness that pins CPU affinities.

vikram: For kernel flags propose: `--fused-attn`, `--no-precompute`, and 8-bit kernels with per-channel quant. We'll iterate kernel patches, capture perf counters.

marisol: I'll coordinate with Armada PM (cc in partner thread) for hardware availability and non-disclosure scoping. Comms: legal needs 72h to review any joint announcement.

jordan: Can we reuse the sapphire telemetry playbook? The scripts live in `eng/ml/bench/suite/energy/`. I can start a scaffold job template.

bench-bot: benchmark-run queued by jordan for test `armada-7b-int8-v1` — estimated run time 3h 12m.

vikram: Quick sanity numbers from local dev rig (rough):
```
7b-int8: 1200 tokens/s @ 250W => 4.8 tok/s/W
13b-fp16: 800 tokens/s @ 300W => 2.7 tok/s/W
```
These are dev — expect partner hw to vary.

marisol: Action items: (1) vikram: kernel tuning plan + PR checklist by EOD Fri; (2) natalie: infra job templates + energy probe by Mon; (3) jordan: baseline runs on our infra Tue-Wed; (4) marisol: NDA + availability w/ Armada. Comms draft for announcement: who wants to take?

alex: I'll draft the announcement outline after first validated run. @natalie please include data schema for published tables (tokens, power, batch, model, kernel_tag).

natalie: Will do. Proposed schema: csv columns `run_id, model, batch, seq_len, tokens_s, power_w, tok_per_w, p50_ms, p99_ms, kernel_tag`

vikram: Also propose we version kernel patches as `kpatch/armada-2026-<id>` and keep a performance regression test in CI.

marisol: :thumbsup: calendar invite for sync tomorrow 10am PT — link in bio. Let's limit to 30m.

alex: Thanks — moving to partner thread and loop in Comms + Legal after we have preliminary numbers.
